subject: Copywriting
title: The Power of Specificity
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Power of Specificity usable.

hook.text: 'We helped thousands' is weak. 'We helped 2,437 businesses grow 34% in 90 days' is strong. Specificity is proof.

buildup.text: Specific numbers feel researched. Round numbers feel guessed.

discovery.text: Specific details create a halo of credibility.

twist.text: Fabricating specific numbers is fraud and will be caught. The specificity must be real. Honesty enables the technique.

climax.text: Replace every vague word in your sales letter with a number, a date, or a name.

quiz.question: Why does $97 feel more credible than $100?
options: Specific numbers feel calculated, not guessed
